subject.title: feat: expose resolved backend model in session_status and agent runtime

question: Should OpenClaw add explicit resolved-runtime metadata to the core session/run/status contracts, and which surfaces should be authoritative?
rationale: This changes provider/session API semantics across persistence, Gateway rows, agent runtime metadata, and user-visible status output, so automation should not pick the permanent contract shape alone.

options.title: Add additive resolved metadata
options.body: Add optional resolved provider/model/fallback fields alongside existing selected model fields and validate them against at least one routing proxy before exposing them broadly.

options.title: Only reconcile existing model fields
options.body: Keep the current `model`/`modelProvider` shape and improve status display, accepting that requested-vs-resolved history remains ambiguous.

options.title: Defer to transport-only work
options.body: Route only the HTTP/header side through https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/22021 and leave agent/session introspection for a later design.

recommendation.title: Add additive resolved metadata
recommendation.body: Add optional resolved provider/model/fallback fields alongside existing selected model fields and validate them against at least one routing proxy before exposing them broadly.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history across session rows, runtime package extraction, and provider/session surfaces.
